mapper.insert: INSERT INTO smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_candidate (id, name, email, mobile, source, referrer_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{source}, #{referrerId}, 0, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_resume (id, candidate_id, job_position_id, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, parse_status, screening_status, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{candidateId}, #{jobPositionId}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{parseStatus}, 0, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id FROM smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_candidate c INNER JOIN smart_recruit_system.sys_user u ON c.mobile = u.mobile WHERE u.id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
